summary:
CEILING AIR DEVICES TO BUY: 31 total — 28 ceiling supply diffusers + 3 ceiling return/exhaust grilles. All quantities counted from the hexagonal device tags on M101 (Mechanical New Work Floor Plan); types/sizes from the GRILLES schedule on M601.

CEILING SUPPLY DIFFUSERS — 28 ea:
• Type A — Price SCD, 6"Ø round neck, white, 4-way — 5 ea (75, 130, 75, 90, 75 CFM)
• Type B — Price SCD, 8"Ø round neck, white, 4-way — 4 ea (150, 150, 140, 140 CFM)
• Type C — Price SCD, 10"Ø round neck, white, 4-way — 15 ea (300, 250, 250, 300, 200, 200, 375, 375, 250, 250, 375, 375, 350, 350, 350 CFM)
• Type D — Price SCD, 12"Ø round neck, white, 4-way — 1 ea (500 CFM)
  A/B/C/D are all the same product family: louvered-face square 4-cone steel ceiling supply diffuser, fixed 360° discharge, full-faced louvers, factory-insulated backpan, in a 24x24 panel for lay-in (grid) ceiling, NC max 35. Schedule note 12 requires a radial balancing damper in the neck of each — Price VCR9 or equal — so order 25 VCR9 dampers (6", 8", 10", 12" to match).
• Type J — Price SMD, 12"x12" face with 8"Ø neck, white, 4-way — 3 ea (175, 150, 150 CFM)
  Louvered-face high-capacity steel ceiling supply diffuser with FLANGED FRAME FOR SURFACE MOUNTING (hard/gyp ceilings — these are the toilet-room units), with opposed blade damper, NC max 35. Do not order these as lay-in.

CEILING RETURN / EXHAUST GRILLES — 3 ea:
• Type F — Price 80, 24"x24" core, white — 3 ea (no balance CFM scheduled)
  All-aluminum 1/2"x1/2"x1/2" egg crate exhaust/return grille, CORE ONLY panel, in a 24x24 panel for lay-in ceiling. M101 note 4: contractor also provides a new 24x24 lined (1/2" liner) plenum atop each new eggcrate return grille.

Ceiling supply air total = 6,550 CFM.

NOT ceiling — do not include in the ceiling count (15 ea SIDEWALL grilles, ordered separately):
• E — Price 95, 30x18, primecoat, heavy-duty 0° deflection sidewall RETURN grille, surface-mount flanged frame — 4 ea. Schedule flags this with "*" and M101 note 7 says the engineer could not field-measure these: 30x18 is approximate, FIELD VERIFY EXACT SIZE BEFORE ORDERING.
• G — Price 95, 36x36, primecoat, heavy-duty sidewall TRANSFER grille, surface-mount — 4 ea (M101 note 3: top elevation 14'-8" AFF).
• H — Price 520D, 18x8, primecoat, double-deflection sidewall SUPPLY register w/ opposed blade damper — 3 ea (550 CFM each).
• I — Price 520D, 14x8, primecoat, double-deflection sidewall SUPPLY register w/ opposed blade damper — 4 ea (450 CFM each). Also flagged "*" — field verify size before ordering.
E, G, H and I all get 2 coats of field paint, color verified with the architect (schedule note 13).

Grand total supply air (ceiling + sidewall) = 10,000 CFM exactly, which cross-checks the tag readings.

THREE MORE CEILING OPENINGS THAT ARE NOT GRILLE PURCHASES: the plan carries three hexagon tags with a dash in the type field (450, 450 and 75 CFM). These sit on exhaust fans EF-1, EF-2 (Greenheck SPA-700, 450 CFM ea) and EF-3 (Greenheck SP-B90, 75 CFM) — per the EXHAUST FANS schedule these are centrifugal CEILING exhaust fans with INTEGRAL GRILLE (plus flapper backdraft damper, plug/cord set, mounting brackets and factory grille-mounted motion sensor). The grille comes with the fan; do not order separately or you will double-buy.

NOTHING IS SALVAGED/REUSED: MD101 notes 8, 14 and 16 call for removing the existing ceiling supply grilles, sidewall supply grilles and sidewall return grilles with "see new work drawings for installation of new grille" — so every tagged device above is a new purchase. MD101 note 18 leaves some existing ceiling-mounted transfer grilles in place (not purchased). MD101 itself carries no device tags.

Method/confidence: the PDF has no text layer, so I counted the hexagonal device tags as vector geometry on M101 — 49 six-segment closed paths at 28.3 x 24.6 pt, all inside the plan area, each then rendered at 420-500 dpi and read individually. A loosened search found only 7 additional near-matches, all at x>2790 pt inside the title block (letterforms in the project name), so the 49 is a complete count.

return_exhaust_grilles.size: 30x18 approx - FIELD VERIFY before ordering (sidewall return)

excluded_false_positives: M101 tags with a dash in the type field (450, 450, 75 CFM): these are the integral grilles of ceiling exhaust fans EF-1, EF-2, EF-3, not orderable grilles - grille ships with the fan
7 hexagon-like vector paths at x>2790 pt on M101: letterforms in the title-block project name, outside the plan area
Types E (4), G (4), H (3), I (4) = 15 grilles: scheduled/noted as SIDEWALL (notes 10 and 11), so excluded from the ceiling-vent count although still part of the job
MD101 note 18 existing ceiling-mounted transfer grilles: 'to remain', not purchased
MD101 carries zero device tags (0 hexagons) - demolition sheet, nothing to order from it
